llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及Ti-6Al-4V激光焊接及焊后热处理，而非增材制造后处理，与研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies laser welding of Ti-6Al-4V with oxide flux coatings and post-weld heat treatment, not additive manufacturing post-processing; it does not address fatigue or mechanical performance of AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究氧化物涂层和焊后热处理对激光焊接Ti-6Al-4V合金性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用不同氧化物涂层进行CO2激光焊接，随后进行焊后热处理，分析微观组织和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 氧化物涂层和焊后热处理显著影响焊接接头的微观结构和拉伸性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微观察和拉伸试验验证性能变化

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to investigate the effect of oxide flux coatings and post-weld heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of CO2 laser-welded Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Different oxide flux coatings were applied prior to CO2 laser welding, followed by post-weld heat treatment; microstructural analysis and tensile testing were conducted.
summary_en.result: Both oxide flux coatings and post-weld heat treatment significantly altered the microstructure and tensile properties of the welded joints.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural observation and tensile testing.
